item.title: Justin Hawkins Explains Why Yungblud’s Ozzy Tribute ‘Doesn’t Ring Authentic’
item.description: Yungblud took the MTV VMAs stage on September 7 alongside Steven Tyler, Joe Perry, and Nuno Bettencourt in a performance meant to honor the late Ozzy Osbourne (watch below).

item.title: JACK OSBOURNE Slams ROGER WATERS Over OZZY: 'My Father Always Thought You Were a C@#$%'
item.description: Jack Osbourne did not tiptoe after Roger Waters said he never cared about Black Sabbath and “couldn’t give a f@#$%” about Ozzy Osbourne, Jack answered with a blunt message of his own.

item.title: Roger Waters Says He Never Liked Ozzy Osbourne Or Black Sabbath: 'I Couldn't Give A @#$%!'
item.description: Roger Waters, the former Pink Floyd leader, said he never cared for Ozzy Osbourne or Black Sabbath, and he delivered it with his typical nuclear frankness. Subtle? Not his brand.

item.title: 'Bats Would Like a Word': PETA Slammed for Praising OZZY OSBOURNE’s Animal Activism After His Death at 76
item.description: After Ozzy Osbourne’s death at age 76, tributes came pouring in from around the world. Fans, musicians, and public figures honored the legendary frontman of Black Sabbath. But one tribute in particular sparked confusion and criticism: a memorial from People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA).

item.title: Linkin Park's MIKE SHINODA Says Fan Backlash to EMILY ARMSTRONG Was About Gender: 'She Wasn't a Guy'
item.description: Linkin Park’s return to the stage after a seven-year break has been met with applause, confusion, and loud opinions online. The band has a new album, a global tour, and a different voice at the front of the stage: Emily Armstrong, formerly of Dead Sara.

item.title: JANE’S ADDICTION Bandmates Sue PERRY FARRELL for 10 Million Over Onstage Fight; FARRELL Responds With Countersuit Alleging Years of Bullying and Harassment
item.description: Members of the rock band Jane’s Addiction have filed a $10 million lawsuit against frontman Perry Farrell, following a public onstage fight in Boston that ended their 2024 reunion tour (via Rolling Stone).

item.title: Fans Slam MARILYN MANSON's Tribute at BLACK SABBATH Farewell: 'Disgraceful' Appearance Sparks Backlash
item.description: Marilyn Manson’s surprise appearance, albeit virtual, during Black Sabbath’s farewell concert on July 5 has sparked a wave of criticism from fans online and at the venue.

item.title: STEVE DIGIORGIO On Recording With DAVE MUSTAINE: 'He Wasn't What I Expected'
item.description: Steve DiGiorgio, longtime bassist for Testament, has spoken candidly about his brief but intense experience recording with Dave Mustaine for Megadeth’s album The Sick, The Dying… And The Dead!

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Talks About IRON MAIDEN Drama: 'It’s Just The Singer I Can’t Stand'
item.description: Sharon Osbourne still hasn’t let it go. Two decades after the absolute circus that was Ozzfest 2005, she’s perfectly willing to laugh about sabotaging Iron Maiden with beans, pre-recorded sound effects, and strategic sound cuts.

item.title: Far-Right Politician Tries to Cancel SLIPKNOT and JUDAS PRIEST Shows in Italy
item.description: Alcide Mosso, a member of Italy’s far-right Lega Nord party, has launched an attack on the Ferrara Summer Festival, held throughout the summer in the city of Ferrara.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE Says FAITH NO MORE's Mike Patton Is 'An Unprofessional Jerk'
item.description: Dave Mustaine has spent over 40 years running the Megadeth machine as guitarist, vocalist, songwriter, and self-appointed keeper of thrash metal’s purity. In that time, he’s built not only an impressive discography, but a side hustle in speaking his mind with the grace of a sledgehammer.

item.title: Cedric Bixler-Zavala Calls Out Linkin Park's New Vocalist Amid Controversy
item.description: Ok I know, if you’re tired of hearing about Linkin Park, this week’s been a real test of patience. And for those of us who’ve never cared much for the band to begin with, it’s been even worse.
